q1: SELECT bar FROM Serves GROUP BY bar HAVING COUNT(beer) >= 5
q2: WITH BarsThatServeBeers AS (SELECT bar, beer FROM serves), BarsAndTheCountOfBeersTheyServe AS (SELECT bar, COUNT(DISTINCT beer) AS count FROM BarsThatServeBeers GROUP BY bar), BarsThatServeLessThan5Beers AS (SELECT bar FROM BarsAndTheCountOfBeersTheyServe AS a WHERE a.count < 5) SELECT a.bar FROM BarsThatServeBeers AS a, BarsThatServeLessThan5Beers AS b WHERE NOT a.bar IN (SELECT * FROM BarsThatServeLessThan5Beers)
